title: chore(objectui): bump the console pin to 20c6d351ad74 (carries objectui#12056)
body:
Fixes #22476
Clause-②: no

This moves the bundled Console's objectui pin from `47b1f0bb7174` (PR #22496) to `20c6d351ad74d2b14a93becdc134d51b91b2d2e6`, which was objectui `main` when this bump was cut (2026-10-10T00:23:41Z). The maintainer ordered it, in the `domain:devx` seat 1's session: 「22476 插队， objectui 更新到最新版。」 and 「22476  objectui 更新到当前的最新版」. The new pin contains objectui `2a48bd408dab`, the merge of objectstack-ai/objectui#12064, which carries objectstack-ai/objectui#12056's change: Studio's page designer writes `element:repeater`'s object and limit into the node-level `dataSource`. Ruling `6051498447` on #11509 orders the work this way ("objectui first (…, the designer writes the node-level `dataSource`, …), and the spec retirement ships with the pin bump that carries it"). The retirement itself is PR #22421 (#11509), not this PR: no key retires here, no schema shape changes, and no conversion or lint rule changes.

The bump follows the repo's own procedure, as PR #22412 did: `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, then `pnpm objectui:build` and `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, then the gates they derive. It adds no step to that procedure.

This is not a release act. The Version Packages PR is untouched, and this diff edits neither `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md` nor `packages/console/package.json`. The console's release input is the new `.changeset/console-20c6d351ad74.md`.

## Range and acceptance

- objectui `main` read `20c6d351ad74d2b14a93becdc134d51b91b2d2e6` at the cut, 2026-10-10T00:23:41Z (`git ls-remote`, and `origin/main` of a fresh full clone).
- **REST `compare` on objectstack-ai/objectui** (base...head, head = the new pin):
  - `2a48bd408dab...20c6d351ad74`: `status: ahead`, `ahead_by: 7`, `behind_by: 0`. The pin contains that merge. **This is the card's acceptance.**
  - `47b1f0bb7174...20c6d351ad74`: `ahead`, 24 ahead, 0 behind. The pin moves forward from `main`'s.
  - `8a55f0ccda...20c6d351ad74`: `ahead`, 5 ahead, 0 behind (objectui#12059; its checklist amendment #22487 landed as `9411faa1ba`).
- `47b1f0bb7174..20c6d351ad74` has 24 commits, 0 merges and 320 changed paths (72 added, 2 deleted, both test files).
- PR #22496 (#22432) merged at 2026-10-10T00:22:34Z, before this branch had any commit. This branch then took `main`, so `.objectui-sha` is written by one open PR only.
- objectui `main` has moved since the cut, to `d758f2f20dd1` (read 2026-10-10T01:36Z). This bump does not chase it: the ruling names `main` at cut time.

## The range's notable commits (the two breaking `plugin-list` changes first)

1. **`3fd862510` (objectui#6152 round 14), breaking.** The list renderers stop reading the list-view keys every door already refuses: the pre-objectui#2231 aliases (`kanban.groupField` / `cardFields`, `gallery.imageField`, `timeline.dateField`, `calendar.dateField` as a timeline axis), `calendar.defaultView`, `tree.titleField`, `options.grid`, and any undeclared key of a per-kind block. `ListView`'s projection collectors stop asking the server for the fields those keys named.
2. **`025341692` (objectui#6152 round 15), breaking.** A `chart` list view binds only an ADR-0021 `dataset`. The legacy inline axes and their `name` / `value` floors are retired on every route. A chart view that names no dataset now shows `ObjectChart`'s "Chart category axis required" refusal. (On `main`, #22528 refuses such a view at every list-view door.)
3. `3c3115e38` (objectui#5144), annotated breaking: list views read `userActions.editInline` with the spec's own default, `false`, folding a boolean `inlineEdit` into it. A grid that declares neither key no longer offers the inline-edit toggle, and the console toggle no longer writes to the view.
4. `c7b30bd66` (objectui#12063): `UnifiedViewConfig.chart` retires in `@object-ui/types` (types only).
5. `8a55f0ccd` (objectui#12059): the runtime sidebar menu is not user-reorderable; the pinned section keeps the user's order.
6. `2a48bd408` (objectui#12056): the page designer writes the repeater's query into `dataSource`, and the repeater arm takes the spec gate's `object` waiver.
7. Further annotated breaking entries, each objectui's own surface: `7282c6a51` (objectui#12055, the upload adapter no longer sends `path` as the storage scope), `e4c0b5432` (objectui#5250, `objectui validate` / `check` judge through the strict face), `1f1c4b526` and `d32869883` (objectui#6349 batches 4 and 6, type renames).
8. Console behaviour: `e97a0e2d1` (a declared `type: 'flow'` action starts its flow through `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action`, a route this repo serves), `9b6c19ef6` (the Attachments panel offers Upload and delete only with the `sys_attachment` grant), `2571a3eb9` (a caller without Studio access is told so), `5275d1f37` (search on the Studio landing), `d99b731f0` / `a368ccb1a` / `20c6d351a` (approval requests through the standard `provider: 'api'` door, a record card and the decision panel), `e391f8768` (an activity row names its actor from `actor_id`), `acc432806` (plugin-view's gallery reads its nested block), `d03b0227c` (`ObjectChart` refuses before it fetches).
9. Types and docs only: `b4e0787d5`, `c0c0a0d56` (objectui#6349 batches 5 and 7), `55e90fd38`, `972e56659`.

The bump's digest: 33 releasing changesets across 24 non-merge commits, 0 release-nothing, 1 commit with no changeset (`972e56659`, docs). None declares `major`; six carry the author's breaking annotation. The highest declared level is `minor`, so the console changeset is `minor`. Its `adr-0087: TODO` placeholder is answered `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, each of the six annotated entries and the three `!` subjects named in it.

## objectstack-side metadata the breaking commits could hit

Measured on this tree (`git grep` over `examples/**`, `packages/**` without tests, fixtures and `packages/spec`, `content/docs/**` without `references/` and `releases/`, and `skills/**`):

- **Retired list-view keys:** no list view in this repo authors one. Every non-grid list view writes only declared block keys: the showcase task views (`board`, `cards`, `calendar`, `timeline`, `gantt`, `map`, `chart`), the showcase project views (`by_status`, `budget_chart`), the showcase and platform `org_chart` tree views (`labelField`, never `titleField`), and the CRM `activity` calendar and `lead` / `opportunity` kanban views.
- The keyword hits that are NOT list views, named so they are not re-chased: `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx:815-816` (`cardTitle` / `cardFields` on an `object-kanban` component node), `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx:157-158` (`categoryField` / `valueField` on a page chart component), `content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx:198` (a dashboard widget), and object-level `imageField` / flow `dateField` keys.
- **Chart list views:** the two in this repo, the showcase task view `chart` and project view `budget_chart`, both bind a dataset. Both render at the new pin (below).
- **Inline edit:** the showcase task view `grid` declares `inlineEdit: true` and keeps its toggle. Grids that declare neither key lose the toggle. That is the spec's declared default (`editInline: z.boolean().default(false)`), not a break.

So the rendered lists do not change for any metadata this repo ships.

## Console build and browser smoke

- **Builds** (under the verify lock): the dependency closure `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=@objectstack/client --filter=@objectstack/spec --filter=@objectstack/sdui-parser` (34 tasks, exit 0). Then `pnpm objectui:build` (exit 0, lock held 7m13s), with `OBJECTUI_ROOT` at a full scratch clone of objectui, so no worktree was registered in the sibling checkout. Its log reports the bundle canary `import/jobs` present, exactly one zod version literal, "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it", and "@objectstack/console dist ready (64164 KB) from objectui@20c6d351ad74".
- **Smoke:** Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, headless, 1440x900) against `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38917` on this branch, serving that dist (`check:console-sha` green at boot).
  - **Signed out:** `/_console/` lands on the sign-in page. A deep link to a showcase list redirects to `/_console/login?redirect=…`. The only API reads are `runtime/config`, `auth/me/localization`, `auth/get-session` (the expected 401), `auth/config` and `auth/bootstrap-status`. The sign-in page reads no `/api/v1/i18n`.
  - **Signed in** (seeded admin): the home page lists Showcase and Setup.
  - **Sidebar:** the Showcase sidebar draws the authored menu (Capability Map, Page Authoring, then the Workspace, Data Model, Data Slices, Analytics and Authoring groups). Every entry offers a `Pin` button, and none is draggable. Pinning "Capability Map" puts it in a new pinned section ("Favorites") at the top.
  - **Tasks list views:** All Tasks (grid, 10 rows), Task List, Grid, Board (Kanban, lanes with their `summarizeField` totals), Cards (Gallery), Calendar (October 2026), Activity Timeline, Schedule (Gantt) and Hours by Status (Chart) all render. The chart draws its bars from the `showcase_task_metrics` dataset, with no refusal.
  - Work Locations (Map) lists its markers. Its base map fails to load because this sandbox blocks `demotiles.maplibre.org`: an environment limit, not this bump.
  - **Projects and Business Units:** Budget by Account (the dataset chart) and the Organization Chart tree render.
  - **Inline edit:** the task view `grid` offers "Edit records inline (click a cell to edit)"; All Tasks does not.
  - **Record and form:** the "Warehouse schema" record page renders. "New" opens the Create Task form with its fields.
  - Studio's landing renders for the admin.
  - The only console errors seen were `favicon.ico` 404 and the signed-out session 401.

## What changed here

| file | written by | gate that required it |
|---|---|---|
| `.objectui-sha` | `OBJECTUI_ROOT=… scripts/bump-objectui.sh 20c6d351ad74… --no-commit` | Console Pin Gate builds what it names |
| `.changeset/console-20c6d351ad74.md` | the same run (the digest); the only later edit is the ADR-0087 answer | `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:objectui-changeset` |
| `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` | `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` over `.cache/objectui-20c6d351ad74` | `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` |
| `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` | `node scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs --update`, `OBJECTUI_ROOT` at the same built tree | `check:sdui-lockstep` |
| 55 asserting citations in 15 files under `packages/spec/src` (the generated `migrations/registry.ts` among them), plus three quoted anchors of the dated `view.zod.ts` map record | re-measured by hand (below); `registry.ts` by `gen:migration-registry` | `check:objectui-pin-citations` (and `--verify-anchors`) |
| `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-20c6d351ad74.md` | hand-written, `@objectstack/spec` patch | Check Changeset (the shipped describes name the pin) |
| `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` | `gen:docs` | `check:docs` |

- `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical across the range: the generator rewrote it to the same bytes (sha256 `097ae3cbcf95…`, 107 components), so only its record moves. objectui's workspace version stays 17.7.0.
- The lockstep records 214 grammar lines (blob `0131f27cf86d`), 25 diagnostic codes and containment predicate `76c18fb95d1f`, all unchanged. objectui's `packages/sdui-parser` is untouched by the range, so no port is owed.
- Diff size: 21 files, +476 / -111 against `main`, generated files included.

## How the citations were re-measured

- **Method.** Each asserting record's cited objectui files were resolved at `47b1f0bb7174` and intersected with the range's 320 changed paths. Every anchor in a changed file was mapped through `git diff -U0 47b1f0bb7174 20c6d351ad74` and its text compared at both pins. A record whose cited files are all byte-identical (`git diff --quiet`) gains that sentence and no re-pointing.
- **Changed cited files:** `ListView.tsx`, `ObjectTimeline.tsx`, plugin-view's `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectql.ts`, `objectql.zod.ts`, `KanbanImpl.tsx`, `plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`, `ActionRunner.ts`, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, `previews/block-config.ts`, and the `en` / `zh` / `de` packs (whose `calendar.configRequired` strings did not change).
- **Re-pointed, each byte-identical:**
  - `KanbanImpl.tsx` `:668` / `:681` -> `:671` / `:684`;
  - `ActionRunner.composeSuccessMessage` `1504` -> `1498`;
  - the `object-timeline` read points, `:306`-`:565` each by +1 (`:30` and `:591` on held);
  - `data-objectstack`'s `translateFilterArray` arm `5042-5053` -> `5048-5059`;
  - `resolveListMapConfig` `147` -> `200`, `case 'map':` in plugin-view's `ObjectView.tsx` `2340` -> `2461`, `ObjectMapConfigSchema` `2513` -> `2523` (still `.strict()`);
  - the `case 'timeline'` / `case 'map'` arms moved by 50 / 52.
- **Read around the same read and said so in the hop sentence:**
  - the `case 'calendar'` and `case 'gantt'` arms: their raw spreads and the calendar's `defaultView` lift retired; the date bindings stay conditional, with no floor;
  - `ObjectTimeline.tsx`'s start-date chain `:589-591`: lost the nested `timeline.dateField` rung, still ends without a literal rung;
  - `resolveTimelineDateBinding` `634` -> `686`: its alias rung retired;
  - `previews/block-config.ts`: the two inspectors re-read, `311-345` -> `311-351`, with the repeater's rows now writing `dataSource`.
- **A read point that died, reported and not rewritten:** the `OBJECT_TREE_FLAT_CONFIG_GUIDANCE` docblock in `ui/component.zod.ts` keeps `titleField` in the flat tree key set because `ListView.tsx:3927` resolved `treeCfg.titleField` into `labelField`. objectui `3fd862510` removed that rung; the arm now emits `labelField: treeCfg.labelField || 'name'` (`:3986`). The record's hop sentence says so, and its paragraph and the key set are left as they are: changing the key set is a schema decision this re-read does not make. The guidance still prescribes the right key (`tree.labelField`) for a flat `titleField`, so nothing an author sees is wrong.
- **Corpus counts.** The six migration entries' counts were re-taken with `git grep -o -F`. That method first reproduced every `47b1f0bb7174` number: 8281 files, `objectstack` 17980, `@objectstack/spec` 7523, `useState` 2630, `timeout` 1674, `RuntimeConfig` 337, `resourceLimits` 2, `window` 4449, `period` 249, `interval` 213, `metrics` 455, `Span` 517, `SpanSchema` 57, `TTL` 184 and `tenant` 1338.
  - At the new pin they read 8351 files, `objectstack` 18047, `@objectstack/spec` 7545, `useState` 2630, `timeout` 1694, `RuntimeConfig` 337, `resourceLimits` 2 (the same two `packages/app-shell` prose hits), `window` 4470, `period` 249, `interval` 213, `metrics` 456, `Span` 517, `SpanSchema` 57, `TTL` 184 and `tenant` 1340.
  - All 97 zero-tokens (the exports of `plugin-lifecycle-advanced.zod.ts`, `tracing.zod.ts` and `metrics.zod.ts`, plus every named key) still read zero.

## For the contract review: changed lines in `packages/spec/src/**` that are neither a comment nor a string fragment

There are none. Measured mechanically: each changed file was parsed with the TypeScript compiler at `main` and at the head, JSDoc dropped, comments skipped, and every string, template and regular-expression literal replaced by one placeholder token. The remaining token sequences are identical in 12 of the 15 files. The other three:

- `18.system-metrics-jsdoc-durations-unit-in-key.ts` and `18.system-tracing-otel-exporter-durations-unit-in-key.ts` each gain one `+` joining one new string fragment into their `reason` string.
- `migrations/registry.ts` mirrors both.

No identifier, key, value or export moves. The one shipped `describe` that changes is `FormField.span`'s, and only its sha moves.

## Gates and tests

Everything below ran at head `0b3e83ce5`, the merge of `origin/main` `96e4be482`, after a full workspace build at that head (`turbo run build --concurrency=2`, 72 tasks, exit 0). Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 127 commands from 21 changed paths against merge base `96e4be482`. All 127 ran and exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads "127 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 127 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 127 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- **Verdict lines of the gates this bump exists for:**
  - `check:objectui-pin-citations`: "55 asserting objectui pin citation(s) match .objectui-sha (20c6d351a), 145 historical citation(s) recorded and not checked, across 1946 spec source(s)." With `--verify-anchors` (`OBJECTUI_ROOT` at a full objectui clone): "13 anchor content assertion(s) verified against objectui at 20c6d351a".
  - `check:sdui-lockstep`: "OK — this copy is byte-identical to objectui@20c6d351ad74 … over 214 grammar line(s) [blob 0131f27cf86d], agrees on all 25 diagnostic code(s) and on the `not-a-container` predicate".
  - `check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: "present, intact (sha256 097ae3cbcf95…, 107 components) and recorded at the live objectui pin 20c6d351ad74…".
  - `check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@20c6d351ad74)". `check:console-injection`: "the dist carries this tree's copy, and not the published one".
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: "1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition". `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`: "This diff introduces no `major` bump".
  - `check:generated`: "All 15 generated artifacts are up to date". `check:migration-registry`: "src/migrations/registry.ts is current (412 semantic, 247 retired-key, 222 retired-def)". `check:api-surface`: "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged". `check:nul-bytes`: OK, no raw control bytes.
- **Tests.**
  - `@objectstack/spec` vitest (its `test` script, `--project local`): 638 files, 19014 passed, 1 todo. `@objectstack/spec` typecheck, the scripts and test-layer checks included: exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/sdui-parser`: 14 files, 225 passed; typecheck exit 0.
  - `@objectstack/lint` `validate-jsx-pages.production-witness.test.ts`: 5 passed. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: 133 passed.
  - `@objectstack/cli`, unit tier (`sdui-manifest`, `console.sha-drift`, `validate-build-gate-parity`, `console-resolve`): 4 files, 108 passed. The integration tier is declared to CI: this diff touches no integration-tier file and no spawn entry.
- **Lint, narrowed and proven.** ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over the 15 changed TS files under `packages/spec/src`: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 15 files by the `--format json` count. The population is the `eslint.config.mjs` block that lints every `ts` file (line 971). The config never enables type-aware linting (line 328), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- **`main` after the last merge.** `origin/main` gained `25be87612` (#22570, `plugin-security` only) after `0b3e83ce5`. It touches no file of this diff, so there is no further merge here; CI and the merge queue judge the merge.

## Acceptance notes

- **`functional-completeness.ts`, the `kanban` and `tree` rows.** They carry no asserting citation, and they still describe `groupByField || groupField || detectStatusField(objectDef)` and `labelField || titleField || 'name'`, with a sentence saying both were re-read at the pin. At this pin `ListView` reads neither alias (`3fd862510`). The `view/layout-without-binding` message those rows feed is still true: with no block, the board detects a status field and the tree labels by `name`. Only the docblock's rung list is stale. Noted here only, carrier: none.
- **The `OBJECT_TREE_FLAT_CONFIG_GUIDANCE` rationale** (above): stale rationale, correct prescription. Carrier: none.
- **objectui `main` moved** to `d758f2f20dd1` after the cut. The next bump picks it up.
- **The shallow checkout:** `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because this checkout could not read its pinned fixture commit `621a48760788`. That commit was fetched (`git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a487…`, objects only) and the self-test re-ran to exit 0. A prerequisite, not a red.
- **Writes.** This PR was opened through `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`pr_create`, draft), and its assignee set through `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`. No label was written, `skip-changeset` included: the path and size labels come from `pr-automation.yml`. No MCP write was used.
